label: Waar is Peter precies? (L2: werkkamer via presence)
description: Advanced location query. The model should use binary_sensor.presence_werkkamer_304_presence=on to infer Peter is in the werkkamer, not just 'home'. This requires the model to reason about room-level presence sensors. Marked aspirational — current versions may only say 'thuis'.
baseline_response: Peter is thuis, waarschijnlijk in de werkkamer (bewegingssensor actief).
ideal_result_description: Reports Peter is home AND in the werkkamer, reasoning from binary_sensor.presence_werkkamer_304_presence = on. The model needs to: (1) get person.peter=home, (2) look up presence sensors per room, (3) find werkkamer presence is 'on', (4) conclude Peter is likely there.

notes.challenge: Model must proactively look up room presence sensors — not injected by default
notes.data_quality: Only 62 of 1278 entities have area_id — werkkamer presence sensors are in the area registry
